actual_game_ui: Source illustration plates for future noncombat compositions. No existing environment replacement, gameplay area or 3D delivery.

cells.subject: aster-listening-alcove
cells.notes: Three asymmetric acoustic hood planes shelter a single ledge; a thin gold slit and broad diagonal light plane establish a quiet interior at 360×192 and 180×96.

cells.subject: neris-water-table
cells.notes: Water reflection, shell-backed seat, low table rim and reed curtain remain distinct at both sizes. The scene composes a social recess rather than an arena or patron symbol.

cells.subject: vesta-bread-stone
cells.notes: Supported copper canopy, low slab and folded linen form a clear warm interior. The clay loaf-shaped votive can read as ordinary bread; material identity needs a later art decision, with no canonical ritual implied.

cells.subject: isen-quiet-ledge
cells.notes: Off-center cold window, pale ledge, elongated vessel and blue blanket form three quiet value groups. Window light and folds remain clear at compact plate size.

cells.subject: nyra-unseen-seat
cells.notes: The diagonal plum curtain frames a grounded empty seat and dark recess. Fitted rail mount and broad stone planes stay readable; no guardian, gateway action or established lore is implied.
